user.title: Weather sensors
user.description: Inputs for the hourly FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET₀ calculation. Temperature, humidity and solar radiation are required; without wind and pressure the calculation still runs on defaults but loses accuracy.

data.viento_minimo: Minimum wind speed for the calculation

data_description.altura_anemometro: Used to convert the measured speed to the 2 m value FAO-56 requires.
data_description.viento_minimo: FAO-56 suggests 0.5 m/s so the aerodynamic term does not collapse in very calm conditions. 0 disables the floor.
data_description.factor_radiacion: Multiplies the sensor reading. Lower it if your station exceeds the theoretical clear-sky maximum, common in sensors deriving W/m² from a lux meter.

prevision.title: Rain forecast and protections
prevision.description: The forecast source is interchangeable: any weather entity exposing precipitation will do.

data.temp_helada: Temperature below which irrigation is skipped

ciclo.title: Cycle planning
ciclo.description: In "finish at sunrise" mode the integration estimates the duration from each zone's measured flow and works backwards to the start time, so the soil is recharged exactly when the plant starts transpiring.

data.modo_inicio: How the start time is decided
data.margen_duracion: Safety margin over the estimated duration

data_description.simulacion: Strongly recommended on install: everything is computed and reported, but nothing is sent to the valves.

zona.title: Irrigation zone
zona.description: Define the first zone. You can add more later from the integration options.

data_description.techo: Absolute per-cycle limit. It must sit ABOVE the legitimate summer peak; if it clips routinely it is rationing, not protecting.
data_description.factor: Multiplies ETc before converting to litres. For localized irrigation and controlled deficit irrigation. 1.0 = full FAO-56 dose.

error.kc_invalido: Enter exactly 12 Kc values between 0 and 3, comma separated.
error.topic_requerido: The zone needs an MQTT topic.
error.zona_duplicada: A zone with that name already exists.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Riego instance is supported; add more zones from its options.

zonas.description: Pick a zone to edit, or add a new one.

ejecutar_ciclo.name: Run cycle
ejecutar_ciclo.description: Runs the water-balance cycle right now.

simulacion.name: Force simulation
simulacion.description: Overrides the global switch for this run only.

regar_zona.name: Water zone
regar_zona.description: Sends a specific dose to a zone, bypassing the water balance.

ajustar_deficit.name: Adjust deficit
ajustar_deficit.description: Sets or corrects a zone's accumulated water deficit.

valor.name: Value (mm)
valor.description: Deficit to set, or increment if relative.

relativo.name: Relative
relativo.description: Add to the current deficit instead of replacing it.

saltar_dia.name: Skip next cycle
saltar_dia.description: The next cycle will only accumulate deficit, without watering.
